title: 1. Hook: The Magic Transformation
text: Imagine a magic trick. You take a hard, crunchy, tasteless potato, put it in a special pot over a fire, and after some time... it becomes soft, warm, and delicious! Have you ever wondered what this 'magic' really is?

title: 2. Socratic Thinking: Why not eat it raw?
text: Think about it. We can easily eat an apple or a carrot just as we pick it. But we can't eat hard grains of rice straight from the farm. Why do you think some foods need to go through this 'magic' process before we eat them? What would happen to our tummies if we tried to eat raw rice?

content.title: 3. Discovery: The Power of Heat
content.description: Heat changes the food! It breaks down the hard parts, kills bad germs, and releases amazing smells and tastes.

title: 4. The Reveal: What is Cooking?
text: This magic process is called **Cooking** (Pakaana - पकाना). Cooking is the process of preparing food by applying heat. It makes our food softer, easier to digest, and completely safe to eat by removing harmful germs!

content.definition: The process of preparing food by using heat to make it soft, tasty, and safe to eat.
Food that is eaten exactly as it is found in nature, without being cooked.

content.question: 5. Knowledge Check: Which of the following foods MUST be cooked before you can eat it safely and comfortably?

title: 6. Reflection: The Tools of the Trade
text: Now, reflect on your own kitchen. Can you cook food in your bare hands? Of course not! We need special tools called **Utensils**. Think about the vessels your family uses. Have you noticed they are made of steel, aluminum, or sometimes clay? Why don't we cook in plastic bowls? (Hint: Think about what heat does to plastic!)

content.title: Ancient History Connection
content.text: In ancient times, early humans ate everything raw! It was only when they accidentally dropped food in fire that they discovered the joy of cooked food. Early utensils were made from baked clay!

title: 7. Connection: Different Ways to Cook
text: Just like we have different ways to travel (car, bike, plane), we have different methods of cooking! We can **Boil** (like potatoes in water), **Fry** (like puris in hot oil), **Roast** (like peanuts on a hot pan), or **Bake** (like cakes in an oven). All of them use heat energy in different ways!

content.title: Common Mistake!
content.text: Many people think ALL food needs cooking. But some foods, like fruits and certain vegetables (carrots, radishes, cucumbers), are meant to be eaten raw to get all their natural vitamins and crunchiness!

content.title: 8. Mastery: The Kitchen Explorer
content.description: Go to your kitchen (with an adult's permission) and observe! Find 3 things that can be eaten raw, 3 things that must be cooked, and 3 things that can be eaten both ways (like tomatoes or carrots). Create your own explorer's list!
